_meta.description: Synthetic HubSpot responses for unit tests and offline dry runs: account details, deal pipelines, and three pages of deals with dealstage history. Every ID, name, and amount is fabricated.
notes: Deals 1001+ are synthetic. About 10% of closed deals have no propertiesWithHistory, so the hs_date_entered_* fallback is exercised.
Six closed deals fall outside a 365-day lookback.
Open deals include one overdue, one without a close date, and one without an amount.
Deal 9001 sits in pipeline 9999, which is not in the pipelines response.
